review.rationale: The prospective TITMAS Finding Adjudication Decision is strictly advisory, bounded, deterministic, and fail-closed. It authorizes exactly two adjudication requests (Lane A and Lane D) and one gated synthesis request to exact model qwen3.7-max, with zero retries, fallbacks, substitutions, or JSON repairs. The frozen PR #23 binding is complete (base/head commits, merge tree, evidence ref, body hash). All 17 expected finding IDs (7 A + 10 D) are explicitly enumerated and bound. The v0.2 adjudication contract enforces a single findings array, preserves source severity, and defines deterministic blocking classification. Supplemental findings D-S01/S02/S03 are bound with source severity and body hashes. Synthesis is gated on both adjudications passing transport, identity, JSON, binding, contract, and coverage checks, plus prior B/C PASS. Stop conditions halt execution on any drift, failure, or unauthorized mutation. The decision explicitly disclaims all candidate, GitHub, code-change, merge, release, and deployment authority. No blockers or corrections are required.
